feudal_manorial.name: Feudal & Manorial Era (Pre-Industrial / Agrarian)
feudal_manorial.description: High social valuation on peasant stability, common land preservation, and customary fallow. Lower valuation on atmospheric emissions.

victorian_industrial.name: Industrial Revolution & Empire of Cotton (1780-1880)
victorian_industrial.description: Intense urban coal smog, river pollution, factory shift wear-and-tear, and enclosure land clearance.

colonial_plantation_egypt_1877.name: Khedivate of Egypt & Export Cash-Crop Enclave (1877)
colonial_plantation_egypt_1877.description: High fragility of Nile alluvial silt, irrigation canal siltation, and sovereign debt enforcement strain.

petrochemical_modern.name: 20th Century Petrochemical & Intensive Agrochemical Age
petrochemical_modern.description: Massive synthetic pesticide toxicity, petrochemical effluent, and heightened carbon smog valuation.
